verdict.rationale: jo documents user-defined scheduled jobs ("Give jo a job and a schedule") and says its always-on machine can "watch what changed" overnight, which is a limited, mostly time-based form of automatic triggering. The evidence does not show user-defined event-to-action rules. missing for 10: explicit user-defined event-condition rules (e.g., on new email or PR, do X), documented trigger types and action configuration, any independent or hands-on corroboration.
